# Proximity

> An immersive management layer for Proxmox based personal infrastructure.

## Overview

Proximity is an open-source platform created by Fabrizio Salmi (@fabriziosalmi) designed to simplify and enhance the management of personal Proxmox VE infrastructure. It features an intuitive SvelteKit user interface, an application catalog for pre-configured LXC containers, container adoption tools, backup/restore mechanisms, and an asynchronous task queue powered by Celery and Redis.

## Core Features & Architecture

- **Proxmox VE API Integration**: Native management of LXC containers and Proxmox cluster nodes.
- **RESTful API**: Comprehensive Django-based API with JWT authentication and granular permissions.
- **Application Catalog**: Pre-packaged templates ready for one-click deployment.
- **Asynchronous Task Engine**: Background task execution with Celery for long-running container operations.
- **Security Audited**: Built-in JWT token verification, CSRF protection, and audit reports.
